//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Difficulty Lock -> Config

Enable Difficulty Lock.//: Whether Difficulty Lock is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

forceHardcoreMode.//: Sets the world game mode to hardcode mode and ignores the other difficulty settings when enabled.

disableCreativeModeSelection.//: Whether Creative Mode should not be possible to select in the world creation screen.

forcedDifficulty.//: The difficulty that is set in any world. Disabled leaves the difficulty as it is. options: Disabled, Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard

forceCheatsDisabled.//: Whether the cheats option should be forced to be disabled on the initial world creation screen.

shouldLockDifficulty.//: When enabled, locks the difficulty in any world so it cannot be changed.

shouldChangeDifficultyWhenAlreadyLocked.//: When enabled, also sets the difficulty in worlds where it has already been locked.
